name: World Without Reason
source:
Two years ago in the spring of 2043, a mysterious figure known as "The Shadow Reaper" tore through the island nation of Calloway City before suddenly vanishing, taking 24 UN Peacekeepers with him.

A year later in the summer of 2044, the Shadow Reaper struck again, this time causing a whopping 32 members of the Calloway City senate to fall into a coma.

It is now the summer of 2045. 

Two years have passed since the Shadow Reaper claimed his first victim. His methods were never discovered, and neither did the available evidence point to any one suspect. With the investigation hitting a standstill, the case has all but gone cold.

Our protagonist seems to know about the Shadow Reaper, but her memory of the last two years is worryingly hazy. 

Can she recall enough details about the case, and her life, before both escape her?

[from [url=https://bamboocalculator.itch.io/world-without-reason]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两年前，2043年春，一名被称作“暗影收割者”的神秘人物席卷岛国卡洛韦城，随后突然消失，并带走了24名联合国维和人员。

一年后的2044年夏，暗影收割者再次出手，这回竟让卡洛韦城参议院的32名议员陷入昏迷。

如今，已是2045年夏。

暗影收割者夺走第一名受害者，已经过去两年。他的作案手法始终未被查明，现有证据也没有指向任何明确的嫌疑人。调查停滞不前，案件几乎成了悬案。

主人公似乎知道暗影收割者的事，可她过去两年的记忆，却模糊得令人担忧。

她能否在案件与人生一同从记忆中消逝之前，想起足够多的细节？

[摘自[url=https://bamboocalculator.itch.io/world-without-reason]itch.io[/url]]
